component.name: TA Engine
component.summary: Clean-room engine recreation of Total Annihilation

description.p: TA Engine is a modern, clean-room re-implementation of Total Annihilation (Cavedog, 1997), written in C++20 with SDL2. It plays the original campaign, skirmishes against the computer and online multiplayer, and includes Cartographer, a port of the original map editor, and taserver, a dedicated multiplayer server.
The game's data is not included: point the engine at your own retail Total Annihilation install (the GOG Commander Pack works).
